The success of Satkar Restaurant and increasing demand for fast-food prompted the group to launch Samrat Restaurant at Churchgate in 1972. The company Kamat Hotels (India) Ltd. was incorporated on 21 March 1986 in Mumbai by Late Mr. Venkatesh Krishna Kamat. The group built a three [[Star Hotel, Great Yarmouth|Star Hotel]] with 32 rooms in the first phase with provision for another 80 rooms at [[Silvassa]]. In 1990 the company owned ''Plaza Hotels Private Limited'' located near Santacruz Airport, Mumbai. Later it became a 4-star property named ''THE KAMAT PLAZA'' designed by an International Designer ''Lynn Wilson'' from USA.{{cite web |title=Kamat Hotels (India) History {{!}} Kamat Hotels (India) Information – The Economic Times |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/kamat-hotels-(india)-ltd/infocompanyhistory/companyid-8642.cms |website=economictimes.indiatimes.com}} The Kamat Group launched its first five-star hotel ''The Orchid Hotels'' in Mumbai. It was partially opened to the public on 27 September 1997, with 221 rooms and 12 suites. The Orchid is an Ecotel Hotel, Asia's first chain of 5 stars.{{cite book |last1=Rothman |first1=Richard M. |title=Master Opportunity and Make it Big |date=2017 |publisher=Jaico Publishing House |isbn=9789386348951 |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=FfQ5DwAAQBAJ&dq=kamat+hotels&pg=PT139 |language=en}} The ''Ecotel'' certificate is awarded by [[HVS Global Hospitality Services]], USA.{{cite web |title=Orchid Hotel – 40 international and national awards won for eco friendly and environment |url=http://stayingat.com/hotels/india/orchidhotel/mumbai_hotels/awards.htm |website=stayingat.com}} The Orchid Hotels are located in [[Mumbai]], [[Pune]] and [[Bhubaneswar]]. In the year 2004, the company founded "Kamfotel" hotel in [[Nashik]].{{cite journal |title=Emergence of Budget Hotels and Metamorphosis of Small sized Commercial Hotels in India |website=sajth.com |volume=3 |page=4 |url=http://www.sajth.com/old/vol3/11%20Saroj%20Kant%20Biswal.pdf}} In 1994, the company made its Initial Public Issue of Equity shares of Rs.10 was issued at a premium of Rs.50. The NCD Issue of the Company was rated "A" by [[CRISIL]]. The above rating was retained by CRISIL till the NCDs were redeemed in 2001.{{cite news |title=Kamat Hotels (India) Stock Price, Share Price, Live BSE/NSE, Kamat Hotels (India) bids offers. Buy/Sell Kamat Hotels (India) News & Tips and latest Announcements – NDTV |url=https://www.ndtv.com/business/stock/kamat-hotels-_kamathotel |work=ndtv.com}} In 1995, the company founded a hotel management school "Kamat's Institute of Hotel Management", and "Kamats Tours & Travels" in Mumbai.{{cite web |last1=Kalist |first1=Shagirtha |last2=Vembar |first2=Vanathi |title=Role of Training and Development in Promoting the Growth of Hospitality Industry |url=https://www.semanticscholar.org/paper/ROLE-OF-TRAINING-AND-DEVELOPMENT-IN-PROMOTING-THE-Kalist-Vembar/8a1a9b94ac843d0ea90ba08ac6b3cdd350ae7749 |date=2011}} Kamat Hotels having the trademark of ''The Orchid Hotels'' as it wins trademark case against [[Royal Orchid Hotels]] in December 2017.{{cite news |last1=Chatterjee |first1=Purvita |title=Kamat Hotels wins trademark case against Royal Orchid Hotels |url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/kamat-hotels-wins-trademark-case-against-royal-orchid-hotels/article9995950.ece |work=@businessline |language=en}} == References == {{reflist}} [[Category:Hotel affiliation groups]] [[Category:Hotel chains in India]] [[Category:Hospitality companies established in 1986]] [[Category:1986 establishments in Maharashtra]] [[Category:Companies based in Mumbai]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1986]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]]
